$comment: Who may read and write each model of prisma/schema/auth.prisma (rules: src/ownership.ts; roles: src/roles.ts). Only office sessions touch them, as factory_runtime inside their own tenant: sign-in, invitations and resets look the person up after the tenant is known (its slug in the sign-in request, its id in every cookie and link), so factory_platform needs none of these tables. The floor and partner roles get no access here; their steps decide what they read. No role deletes: a user is deactivated, sessions are revoked, invitations and resets are marked used or revoked (a purge job comes later). After a change run `npm run policies -w @nexus/factory-db -- <folder>`.

User.about: The people of the tenant: the Office reads and keeps them (sign-in, invitations, the user list and its lifecycle commands).

Session.about: Office sessions: written at sign-in, read on every request (the cookie names the tenant), slid, revoked.

Invitation.about: Invitations by email: written by an administrator, read and marked accepted through the link (the link names the tenant), revoked.

PasswordReset.about: Password reset links: written on request or at a sign-in that needs a new password, read and marked used through the link (the link names the tenant).
